mode: AB-R official effective membership event source

tests: Read original official BOCG 15-D-51 full text, focus PLENO 051/000002 parts A/B/C and original date of bulletin. Count full-condition bajas/altas per dated set, no person vote choices.
Compare full-condition effective days and credential filing days against issue date; make distinct event_type for FULL_CONDITION_ACQUIRED vs CREDENTIAL_SUBMITTED vs FULL_CONDITION_TERMINATED.
Use 2023 JEC original list only to note replacement entries need not appear in original elected proclamation, not claim all eight came from JEC elected file.
Assess whether BOCG current HTML issue day establishes at least a publication-day proxy but not exact first_public_at or evidence in advance of day.
Record original source URL fixed, extraction counts and evidence, no publisher-signed PDF bytes acquired.
accept: 8+8 with effective dates grounded if source confirms; correct temporal negative for retrospective cutoff 2023-12-10 where publication dated 2023-12-15; no automatic as-of exposure backdated.
